name: Cyberchase
description: The series takes place in Cyberspace, a virtual world, and chronicles the adventures of three children, Jackie, Inez, and Matt, as they use math and problem solving skills to save Cyberspace and its leader, Motherboard, from The Hacker, the villain.

The Belly Bowl
videos.overview: The wild chase is on!  In this 6-part adventure across Penguia, three diverse kids called The CyberSquad must stop The Hacker and get their friend Mimi to her first Belly Bowl competition --a luge-like race where penguins slide on their bellies to win the coveted Vince Lombelly trophy.  When Mimi discovers a mysterious map containing a strange code incriminating Hacker, she leaves the competition and calls the CyberSquad for help. Can they stop Hacker before the clock runs out? And what will save the CyberSquad from the mayhem Hacker causes along the way? Sources of energy from nature to the rescue

videos.title: Lost My Marbles
videos.overview: A day at the library turns into a cyberventure when Jackie, Matt, and Inez learn that Hacker has kidnapped Dr. Marbles, the only person who can save Motherboard from an evil virus. The rescuers learn to use a map as a mathematical tool as they navigate across a cyber island in search of Marbles—then try to escape before a huge earthquake turns the island inside out.

videos.title: Castleblanca
videos.overview: Cybersquad must stop Hacker from activating his newest creation, Gigabyte, before the light of the midnight moon, or else Dr. Marbles mind will be transferred into the monster, and Hacker will learn about all of Motherboard's secrets. The kids and Digit know Hacker is in a castle on a spooky, Halloweenish site called Castleblanca. Unfortunately, Motherboard wasn't able to specify which castle he is in. The kids must survey the residents of Castleblanca to pinpoint the exact location where Dr. Marbles is being held captive.

videos.title: R-Fair City
videos.overview: Digit is lured to R-Fair City, a cybersite full of carnival games, where he is kidnapped by a disguised Hacker. The kids must find the unfair/crooked game to find Digit. Meanwhile, they learn about chance and how to spot an unfair chance of winning and losing. Along the way they meet Lucky, a cab driver, who offers them a chance to gain a free cab ride while they search for Digit. Digit is locked in a bird cage with Buzz and Delete as his guards.

videos.title: Snow Day to Be Exact
videos.overview: Hacker is looking for an eternal power source, so he steals Solaria's Sunisphere. The Cybersquad has to get it back before the whole site freezes over.

videos.title: Sensible Flats
videos.overview: Hacker participates in a land rush in which participants cannot build property bigger than Judge Trudy's land. Hacker's land is accused of being bigger than Trudy's, but they turns out to be the exact same size.

videos.title: Zeus on the Loose
videos.overview: The kids fail to stop Hacker from stealing Pandora's box in Mount Olympus, so they must solve a riddle and complete challenges to satisfy Zeus and earn a second chance.

videos.title: The Poddleville Case
videos.overview: Hacker attempts to take power from the vault in Poddleville for himself by stealing the residents' power pods, much to the detriment of the community. Each power pod has a shape and a number from 1 to 12, and after Inez and Matt are imprisoned it becomes a race to solve the pattern and enter the vault.

videos.title: And They Counted Happily Ever After
videos.overview: Wicked casts a spell that erases the memories of the citizens, so that they forget how to count.

videos.title: Clock Like an Egyptian
videos.overview: Dr. Marbles finds the encryptor chip in an ancient pyramid, but the Mummy who guards the pyramid finds Marbles. When the Cybersquad arrives, they must work their way through the chambers of the pyramid, find Dr. Marbles, and escape before a trap set by the Mummy seals them inside forever.

videos.title: The Secrets of Symmetria
videos.overview: Dr. Marbles builds Symmetria because of his passion of symmetry, but Hacker steals the symmetrizer and destroys Symmetria by splitting everything symmetrical in half. The Cybersquad has to figure out how to get the symmetrizer back from Hacker.

videos.title: A Day at the Spa
videos.overview: The kids are assigned to steal a crystal that powers Hacker's gadgets, while distracting Hacker with a series of spa treatments.

videos.title: Of All the Luck
videos.overview: Hacker decides he needs to change his luck from bad to good, so he hires Baskerville, a new henchman, to replace Buzz and Delete while the 10 good luck charms of Cyberspace ensure him good luck. The kids and Digit use logic to rescue the charms and stop Hacker.

videos.title: Eureeka
videos.overview: Professor Archimedes has the encryptor chip, but has to activate the emergency defense system when Hacker arrives to steal it. He and his building shrink to 2D, and the kids and Digit have to put him back to 3D.

videos.title: Cool It
videos.overview: Motherboard is suddenly sickened by the green liquid because of Buzz and Delete. So it's up to Digit and the kids to heal her using blue liquid.

videos.title: Find Those Gleamers!
videos.overview: Hacker challenges the kids and Digit to a game show entitled "Find Those Gleamers!", Gleamers being lightning bugs that power ships such as the Grim Wreaker. The kids have to make their ship, the Grim Wreaker 2, take off before time expires.

videos.title: Codename: Icky
videos.overview: Hacker steals the cyber slug Icky to destroy Aquari-yum, and the kids make a code to fool him.

videos.title: Return to Sensible Flats
videos.overview: Hacker steals all the water from Sensible Flats to buy up their land, and the kids must determine when this started and how to fix it.

videos.title: Problem Solving in Shangri-La
videos.overview: After Hacker kidnaps the kids, he crash-lands in Shangri-La, where Master Pi challenges both groups to a special contest. The winner is free to come and go at will, while the loser has to stay in Shangri-La until they learn to solve the problems.

videos.title: Send in the Clones
videos.overview: Hacker's invention to clone himself accidentally clones Delete instead, leading him to produce 3 clones every time he sneezes. The kids and Digit enlist the help of clone catcher Cy Clone.

videos.title: Trading Places
videos.overview: After crashing into each other's ships and crash-landing, the kids and Hacker must deal with bartering with one another to repair their ships. Also, Buzz and Delete suddenly become brilliant, and an evil genie named Warren disobeys his mother's orders to stay inside his bottle.

videos.title: Less Than Zero
videos.overview: The kids chase Hacker around a building consisting of floors that have both positive and negative numbers.

videos.title: Model Behavior
videos.overview: A Sky Wall is built to protect Happily Ever After from Hacker, but he plans to invade when Wicked's operatic voice will break it. One of the Three Little Pigs secretly aides Hacker after a promise of protection from the Big Bad Wolf, so the kids have to do double duty to expose him and stop Wicked from singing.

videos.title: Fortress of Attitude
videos.overview: Hacker has a statue which broadcasts his voice 24/7. This leads Cybersites to surrender once they can no longer bear it.

videos.title: Size Me Up
videos.overview: Digit and the Cybersquad are tricked into going to a land of giants, with Motherboard unaware of their presence. Hacker leaves them stranded, and threatens to send another deadlier virus to Motherboard. The Cybersquad must escape and stop Motherboard from receiving Hacker's virus.

videos.title: A Battle of Equals
videos.overview: Hacker pollutes Cyberspace with dangerous cyber-static by tampering with four satellites designed to keep everything free from cyber-static cling.

videos.title: Out of Sync
videos.overview: Hacker kidnaps the Beast, a member of a famous band on Mount Olympus. Without him, the band can't perform their music properly and in sync, which causes the Cybersite to begin self-destructing. Its all up to the Cybersquad to reunite the band and save Mount Olympus.

videos.title: Hugs & Witches
videos.overview: Lady Lovelace comes up with a way to eliminate Hacker's virus, but Hacker traps her and Dr. Marbles in her time machine, and programs it to travel to the beginning of time.

videos.title: Totally Rad
videos.overview: Hacker becomes the king of Radopolis, replacing King Dudicus. Then a competition begins and three players in Team Hacker compete against Matt, Jackie, and Inez in Team Motherboard. If Team Motherboard wins, King Dudicus reclaims his throne. If Team Hacker wins, Hacker becomes the king of Radopolis forever and the Cybersquad will never be able to return to Cyberspace. A later amendment to the bargain is that if Team Hacker wins, Inez will have to become one of Hacker's cheerleaders.

videos.title: Harriet Hippo and the Mean Green
videos.overview: Thanks to one of Wicked's spells, Motherboard starts turning all cybersites mean and green. Digit gets the antidote but it breaks, and there isn't another one available to break the spell, so the kids must figure out how to make the antidote before all cybersites turn bad. Meanwhile, Hacker has a romantic encounter with Wicked.

videos.title: True Colors
videos.overview: Hacker starts an election campaign to become the new ruler of Cyberspace, planning to replace Motherboard. He also appears to turn over a new leaf, doing good deeds all around Cyberspace to gain public favor for votes. The Cybersquad must prove that Hacker is lying about being good before the election is over.

videos.title: All the Right Angles
videos.overview: Ivanca the Invincible has a treasure map that Dr. Marbles mails to Motherboard's "buddy list." However, the virus also causes her to mail it to her "baddy list," which gives Hacker the map. Meanwhile, Digit is on an undercover mission for Motherboard, going to Hacker pretending to have reverted to the dark side, into thinking he's turned evil again, to stall him long enough so the kids can find the treasure first.

videos.title: Mother's Day
videos.overview: While Jackie freaks out over what to get her mother for Mother's Day, Hacker wrecks the Mother's Day festival in Cyberspace by interfering with a train shipment of special flowers. Jackie ultimately gets one such flower for her mother.

videos.title: The Eye of Rom
videos.overview: Hacker steals Pyramida's Eye of Rom from its pyramid, which he plans to use against Motherboard. Because of this theft, when the pyramid's shadow hits the Nile River, the site will crash.

videos.title: Whale of a Tale
videos.overview: Hacker reprograms trapeze artist Glowla's robotic whale partner, Spout, into going rogue to destroy R-Fair City.

videos.title: Double Trouble
videos.overview: Hacker steals the Golden Droplet of Shangri-La, which doubles upon being removed from its pot, and doubles forever. He also kidnaps Master Pi for insurance.

videos.title: Raising the Bar
videos.overview: The Cybrary, owned and operated by Ms. Fileshare, has a bug problem, so she hires an exterminator named the Vermin Vexor (Hacker in disguise) to help her with the problem. Hacker instead adds more bugs so all references of Motherboard get switched to himself, and he alters two bar graphs to hide the truth.

videos.title: The Wedding Scammer
videos.overview: Wicked poses as a princess who had announced to get married, and her groom is Hacker. Sam Vander Rom and his co-host plan to air the wedding on cyberwide TV, while the kids look for the real prince and princess.

videos.title: The Guilty Party
videos.overview: In Poddleville, Hacker gets robbed and frames magician Slythe O'Hand and his dog Presto for it.

videos.title: A Time to Cook
videos.overview: Digit and the kids compete against Hacker on the popular cooking game show "Fearless Chef."

videos.title: Trick or Treat
videos.overview: On Halloween, Hacker invades Motherboard Control Central with a toy frog.

videos.title: EcoHaven CSE
videos.overview: Someone has stolen the legendary cyber beast Choocroca from cyberspace EcoHaven.

videos.title: The Borg of the Ring
videos.overview: King Dudicus accidentally uncovers the long-lost "Totally Rad Ring of Radopolis," which grants whoever wears it on their head their hearts desires. The citizens suggest putting it in a safe place where nobody can use it for anything, but Hacker steals it and uses it to attack Motherboard.

videos.title: A World Without Zero
videos.overview: Hacker's insulting letters to Mr. Zero cause him to leave Gollywood, leading all zeros on signs to disappear and further chaos to ensure. However, contrary to what the people think, their main central bank still has all nine million snelfus, which Hacker plans to use to finance all his conquering quests.

videos.title: A Piece of the Action
videos.overview: Hacker doesn't know he is allergic to magnetite, which he uses to plan to erase Motherboard forever. Meanwhile, Hacker keeps a bunch of Scritter hostage, and he subsequently captures Digit.

videos.title: The Creech Who Would Be Crowned
videos.overview: Tikiville crowns its new monarchs with a race, which Creech, once part of a royal family, plans to win. Hacker also enters the race, planning to use the crown to turn Tikiville's giant statues into an army if he wins.

videos.title: The Grapes of Plath
videos.overview: After the prince of crabs takes a dare and becomes dishonest after falling in the Abyss, the kids and Digit must find the Grapes of Plath to restore his ability to tell the truth, located in the Fountain of Truth. Unfortunately, Hacker is pursuing the Grapes as well. Because he thought Motherboard said "Fountain of Youth", and assumes the grapes can and will fix his chin problem.

videos.title: A Perfect Fit
videos.overview: Hacker tries to restore his giant robot, Gigabyte, by using the rays of Jimaya's sun. Delete is excited, but Buzz becomes jealous.

videos.title: Be Reasonable
videos.overview: The Cybrary is under attack again, and the kids have to use logic and elimination processes to stop Hacker from entering Motherboard's vault.

videos.title: The Snelfu Snafu (1)
videos.overview: The kids win the encryptor chip in an auction after saving enough money to buy it, but Hacker infected it and subsequently made himself the ruler of Cyberspace. After saving Dr. Marbles, the kids help him save Motherboard by having to reboot her, destroying the encryptor chip in the process. Meanwhile, Hacker breaks up with Wicked upon discovering she spent all 10 million snelfus on clothes and merchandise.

videos.title: The Snelfu Snafu (2)
videos.overview: The kids win the encryptor chip in an auction after saving enough money to buy it, but Hacker infected it and subsequently made himself the ruler of Cyberspace. After saving Dr. Marbles, the kids help him save Motherboard by having to reboot her, destroying the encryptor chip in the process. Meanwhile, Hacker breaks up with Wicked upon discovering she spent all 10 million snelfus on clothes and merchandise.

videos.title: Shari Spotter and the Cosmic Crumpets
videos.overview: Digit and the kids help Shari of Frogsnorts bake the Cosmic Crumpets. Hacker then attempts to use the magical Cosmic Crumpets to steal the powers of the scorcerers of Frogsnorts and become the most powerful magician in Cyberspace. When Hacker steals the sorcerers' powers, the Cybersquad helps Shari restore the magicians' powers.

videos.title: Starlight Night
videos.overview: Hacker tries to destroy the festivities during Cyberspace's favorite holiday, Starlight Night (a mix of Christmas and New Year's Eve in the same day).

videos.title: Balancing Act
videos.overview: The Cybersquad helps Sharri Spotter make a film about Frogsnorts while staying within a budget, but Hacker keeps trying to run the up budget by putting himself in the film.

videos.title: The Icky Factor
videos.overview: Hacker kidnaps Icky to find a power source to power up his new invention so he can use it to rule over Cyberspace again.

videos.title: Penguin Tears
videos.overview: Hacker's secret plan to take over Cyberworld by using the electric eel's energy continues. The missing piece of the puzzle is the Prism of Penguia. Since Emperor Penguia can't remember where he hid the prism, everybody in Penguia has to shed tears until it is found. The Cybersquad & Fluff must face several obstacles, including a booby trap, to "angle" their way out so that nobody no longer has to shed tears.

videos.title: Past Perfect Prediction
videos.overview: Slider's father owes Hacker a debt, and if they don't pay up in time, Hacker will steal and take over his father's garage.

videos.title: Measure for Measure
videos.overview: Hacker's new invention is revealed, and is ready to create chaos.

videos.title: A Change of Art
videos.overview: Hacker plans to use statues of himself to cause a power outage everywhere.

videos.title: The Case of the Missing Memory
videos.overview: Motherboard's memory integrator has been stolen, so Digit and the Cybersquad need to find out what it looks like and who stole it.

videos.title: A Crinkle in Time
videos.overview: Slider gets kidnapped by Hacker and gets brings him to Tick Tockia. The Cybersquad must save their friend from the Hacker.

videos.title: A Broom of One's Own
videos.overview: Wicked builds some Broom and stated that it's a Cybersquad Seal of Approval, even though they didn't even test them. Jackie, Matt and Inez test out the brooms to see if they are faster.

videos.title: A Tikiville Turkey Day
videos.overview: When Hacker steals the legendary Egg of Benedicta, the kids need to get the egg back from Hacker.

videos.title: The Halloween Howl
videos.overview: The annual "Halloween Howl" bash in Castleblanca promises to be spooktacular… until Hacker takes over the Mayor's Castle and brings its seven stone gargoyles to life. Obeying Hacker's every command, the gargoyles capture the Mayor and imprison him in the dungeon. To gain control of the creepy creatures, the Cybersquad must figure out how to use division to evenly split up bunches of garlic and rock candy. But can they do it in time to rescue the Mayor and save The Halloween Howl? Meanwhile, Inez and Jackie are having a problem with their friendship after a misunderstanding.

videos.title: A Clean Sweep
videos.overview: Buzz opens up a new doughnut shop in Radopolis. Hacker's magnetite confetti he collects is large enough to remove the memory of every single citizen of Radopolis and send them to sleep.The Cybersquad needs to design a confetti collector so they can spoil Hacker & save Radopolis before it's too late when he dominates Radopolis and renames it Hackerville.

videos.title: Designing Mr. Perfect
videos.overview: The Wicked Witch of Happily-Ever-Afterville turns Digit into her husband. Wanda enlists the CyberSquad on a mission to Terra Swampa to rescue Digit. But first, they need to design an invention to help them get across the swamp.

videos.title: EcoHaven Ooze
videos.overview: When Hacker takes all the Ooze from EcoHaven for himself, Inez, Jackie, Matt, Digit and Wigit must find a way to shoo Hacker away before the EcoHaven animals lose their energy.

videos.title: The Fairy Borg Father
videos.overview: Delete is having a bad day. But things appear to brighten up when Zanko, a fairy borgfather, comes to grant Delete 9 wishes. Due to Delete's wish about bunnies, almost everybody in Cyberspace becomes bunnies. The only way to turn everyone back into themselves is for the Cybersquad to save Zanko's ladle and for delete to sacrifice his final wish.

videos.title: The Flying Parallinis
videos.overview: Hacker kidnaps Jackie atop Mount Wayupthere and the rest of the Cybersquad must rescue her after meeting a Parallini named Teeny Weeny. In their search for the elusive Diamond Joe - the mysterious figure who holds the secret to Jackie's release.

videos.title: Crystal Clear
videos.overview: Digit is malfunctioning, Motherboard sends the Cybersquad to get his Synchronium crystal and fix him.

videos.title: Inside Hacker
videos.overview: Jackie, Inez and Digit shrink Matt so he can get inside Hacker so he can change back into his good guy form.

videos.title: On the Line
videos.overview: When Hacker manages to get his NIC card back, the Cybersquad must get it back and dispose it before Hacker is able to use his Transformatron again.

videos.title: A Fraction of a Chance
videos.overview: When the Cybersquad returns home from a meeting, Motherboard's portal glitches making them stuck in the vortex. Digit and Wicked work together to find the UVO (Universal Vortex Opener) before the Cybersquad permanently dematerializes!

videos.title: Digit's B-Day Surprise
videos.overview: Hacker tries to ruin Digit's birthday party, though Digit thinks it's actually for Judge Trudy (since that was how the secret was kept from him).

videos.title: When Penguins Fly
videos.overview: Penguins can't fly - or can they? In Cyberspace, on one special night each year, the penguins of Penguia take flight to deliver gifts to young borgs across the virtual universe.

videos.title: Unhappily Ever After
videos.overview: Hacker destroys 3 boxes covering the Book of Unhappy Endings, and releases the Unhappy Endings. The CyberSquad must return the book by sundown.

videos.title: Escape from Merlin's Maze
videos.overview: Hacker traps Shari in Merlin's Maze and the kids try to rescue her by using levers to move stone slabs that are surrounding her.

videos.title: Step by Step
videos.overview: Hacker captures Dr. Marbles and puts him in a faraway volcano, so it's up to the kids to save him.

videos.title: Team Spirit
videos.overview: The Cybersquad prepares to compete in Zeus' Mount Olympus games.

videos.title: Jimaya Jam
videos.overview: The Cybersquad uses diagrams to get out of a basketball-like game called Jimaya Jam.

videos.title: A Perfect Score
videos.overview: Jackie must be Hacker's partner in a dance competition

videos.title: Chaos As Usual
videos.overview: The kids search for patterns in player performance to help defeat Hacker's team of titans.

videos.title: Spheres of Fears
videos.overview: Digit and the kids are trapped in a Sphere of Fear by Hacker, so they rely on the relationship between circumference and diameter to locate the codebook they need to unlock the door.

videos.title: Gone with the Fog
videos.overview: The Cybersquad must figure out dew point to make a rescue under fog.

videos.title: The Emperor Has Snow Clothes
videos.overview: The kids track a powerful storm to save the Emperor of Penguia.

videos.title: The X Factor
videos.overview: A harmless act multiplied hundreds of times creates a huge problem.

videos.title: Blowin' in the Wind
videos.overview: The Cybersquad must measure and compare wind speeds to find the cure to Motherboard's virus.

videos.title: Fathers Day
videos.overview: Creech's dad Max is named "Cyberdad of the Year" for the annual Father's Day parade. However, a jealous Hacker---a one-time classmate of Max's who was always bested by him---sets out to sabotage the event.

videos.title: The Deedle Beast
videos.overview: Digit pet-sits Dewey, a Deedle Beast who suddenly starts going berserk on his daily walk.

videos.title: Spellbound
videos.overview: Wicked uses magic to make the Pompadorians adore her, and it's up to Jackie and Digit to break the spell. But to do so, they need to reproduce the symbol that possesses the power, but have no idea what it looks like. Matt and Inez, however, are able to use the Skwak to describe it to them.

videos.title: The Hacker's Challenge
videos.overview: Hacker challenges the CyberSquad to solve a series of puzzles in three hours. If they fail, he vows to turn the cybersite Solaria into a digital garbage dump.

videos.title: Face-Off
videos.overview: Fluff wants to wear his dad's lucky hockey skates in the prestigious Penguia Cup competition, but his teammates want everyone to wear cool skates they saw advertised on TV.

videos.title: Peace, Love, and Hackerness
videos.overview: When Hacker blasts the pole of the Far-Out radio, it's up to the Cyber Squad to save Cyberspace before the radio dies.

videos.title: Hackerized
videos.overview: Someone has hacked Sensible Flats so that everyone looks and acts like Hacker. The real Hacker tries to find out who did it while the CyberSquad seeks to save the town. To do so, though, they must scale a rocky cliff in less than three minutes.

videos.title: The Bluebird of Zappiness
videos.overview: Hacker teams with the CyberSquad to stop his nemesis Ledge from finding the cure to Motherboard's virus.

videos.title: An Urchin Matter
videos.overview: The Cybersquad must figure out what is causing kelp from Mega Bay to rise to the top. Meanwhile, Hacker looks make some profit by putting on a show for Cyberspace to see, after watching a viral video on CyberTube.

videos.title: Going Solar
videos.overview:
Hacker has challenged Slider to a skate-off. But suddenly, the power to the brand new stadium goes out. The Cybersquad must find a way to harness solar energy, store it, and makes sure it lasts through the game. However, someone keeps sabotaging their plans. The show must go on!

Cybersites: Radopolis

videos.title: Trash Creep
videos.overview:
The team battles a giant garbage heap in Perfectomundo, which threatens to break through the cybersite dome; Hacker seeks to grow an army of monster plants.

Cybersites: Perfectomundo

videos.title: The Cyberchase Movie - Pt.1
videos.overview: Hacker and his bumbling henchbots Buzz and Delete are drilling inside the nature preserve Ecotopia. They're desperately searching for the Emergency Reset Button, which will allow Hacker to re-format all of Cyberspace to his settings...putting him in charge of everyone and everything forever! He accidentally triggers a slime geyser, which destroys many animals' habitats. The overcrowding causes manic monkeys, chaotic crocs and outraged orangutans. The CyberSquad is called in to rescue the animals and restore harmony to Ecotopia. They team up with Ollie (guest star Rico Rodriguez), a Junior Ranger, and quickly learn this isn't their only problem.

videos.title: The Cyberchase Movie - Pt.2
videos.overview: Hacker's careless drilling on Ecotopia set off a slime geyser, which destroyed many animals' habitats. After teaming up with Ollie (guest star Rico Rodriguez) to restore harmony, the CyberSquad learns that rescuing animals isn't their only problem. Ollie's mom has gone missing too. And old friends and longtime foes mysteriously surface as the drama unfolds. Can the kids restore Ecotopia, rescue their friends and prevent Cyberspace from being lost to the villainous Hacker forever?

videos.title: Fit to Be Heroes
videos.overview: The CyberSquad and their new friend Scanner embark on a quest to build a new Encryptor Chip for Motherboard and cure her virus. With Hacker in hot pursuit, the kids must run, ski, canoe and climb their way to the end of the mission. In the process, they learn that a little activity over time adds up. But will they also cure Motherboard?

videos.title: A Recipe for Chaos
videos.overview: A popular new restaurant in Castleblanca serves delicious meals, but all the residents have become cranky and tired. The CyberSquad quickly learns the restaurant's food is unhealthy...and Hacker is behind it all. To get Hacker to stop making his unhealthy food, Digit challenges him to a cook-off. But if Hacker wins, the kids must leave Cyberspace forever! Who will win the hearts--and stomachs!--of Castleblanca?

videos.title: A Seedy Business
videos.overview: The CyberSquad must investigate why Hacker saved the cybersite Factoria. Hacker not only forced the Factorians into making toy helicopters, he also forced them to make free meals known as "junk food," freely distributed in vending machines. Due to the unhealthy food issue, they need to find soil and a sunny place around the site to plant a colorful but healthy garden. In the end, it is revealed that Hacker wasn't hiring them to work on toy copters, instead spy copters built to take over the CyberWorld.

videos.title: Parks and Recreation
videos.overview: Kids in glamorous Gollywood have no safe place to play. When they discover an empty lot that can be converted to a park, they have only one opponent: Hacker. He wants the lot for his new Gollywood Tower, which he claims will broadcast entertainment to all of Cyberspace. (The tower is really meant to corrupt Motherboard's hard drive.) The CyberSquad goes up against Hacker at a city council hearing. Will they get their park, or will Hacker dazzle the council into approving his tower?

videos.title: Bottled Up
videos.overview: Radopolis has a big problem: water bottles. Radsters are an active bunch, but their desire to stay hydrated has led to a huge bottle pile-up. Way Cool Arena has been turned into a bottle dump, and the beloved skate park is next! The kids and Slider must find a way to get rid of the heaps of empties and reduce future waste while making sure Radsters stay healthy. Can they prevent their rad cybersite from getting bottled up?

videos.title: Watts of Halloween Trouble
videos.overview: It’s Halloween Haunt-O-Rama in R-Fair City, and Hacker has a wicked treat up his sleeve: to keep the kids out of Cyberspace forever by crashing Motherboard’s portal system. But when Buzz and Delete make a mistake, the portal system crashes too late, and the kids and Digit are trapped in R-Fair City! Now, the kids must find enough energy to power Digit’s portal rebooter and keep the amusement park going. But with the celebration in full swing, can they find big and small ways to save enough energy? And can they ever get back to Earth again?

videos.title: Creech's Creature Quandary
videos.overview: A disagreement drives a wedge between friends when Inez tells Creech her bike path should be shut down.

videos.title: A Murky Mystery in Mermaidos
videos.overview: On his annual trip to visit Eugene, Digit finds out that poor conditions in Mermaidos have forced many of the fish from their home.

videos.title: Plantasaurus!
videos.overview: Motherboard invites the kids for a slumber party with Digit in Control Central.

videos.title: A Reboot Eve to Remember
videos.overview: Delete joins forces with the CyberSquad to build a giant windmill for the little town of Bottawa after Hacker steals its power source.

videos.title: Housewarming Party
videos.overview: As the Three Pigs celebrate their new cottage with a housewarming party, Hacker and Wicked accidentally zap away Mount Evermore -- which had been protecting the cottage from direct sunlight.

videos.title: Invasion of the Funky Flower
videos.overview: Hacker plots a revenge when he loses to Inez at the annual flower-growing contest.

videos.title: A Renewable Hope
videos.overview: Hacker enlists the help of CyberSquad to get back home.

videos.title: The Migration Situation
videos.overview: Professor Bobson calls on citizen scientists to help when the trillers fail to show up for the Migration Celebration.

videos.title: Back to Canalia’s Future
videos.overview: The kids promise to help Pearl spread the word about the water problem in Canalia, and they convince Canalians to change their water-wasting ways.

videos.title: Space Waste Odyssey - Part 1
videos.overview: It is Motherboard's birthday, but not all is well. The CyberSquad must save Cyberspace on their own when a malfunction renders Motherboard powerless, while the Hacker attempts to crush Control Central between two giant Trash vortexes. They must reboot Motherboard, move the Control Central, and throw a birthday party for Motherboard

videos.title: Space Waste Odyssey - Part 2
videos.overview: It is Motherboard's birthday, but not all is well. The CyberSquad must save Cyberspace on their own when a malfunction renders Motherboard powerless, while the Hacker attempts to crush Control Central between two giant Trash vortexes. They must reboot Motherboard, move the Control Central, and throw a birthday party for Motherboard.

videos.title: Giving Thanks Day
videos.overview: The CyberSquad is excited to celebrate Giving Thanks Day with Jackie's pumpkin pie, but there's a big problem -- Hacker has taken all the pristine produce.

videos.title: A Garden Grows in Botlyn
videos.overview: Ren and the CyberSquad use their math skills to plant a garden in an unlikely space. Meanwhile, Hacker receives an unexpected valentine.

videos.title: Missing Bats in Sensible Flats
videos.overview: Digit's cousin, Brigit, thinks a lack of bats is the reason the flowering cactus plants are not bearing any apple cactus fruit.

videos.title: Water Woes
videos.overview: Buzz and Delete enlist the CyberSquad to figure out why the water supply at Mount Bear Fresh Water Spa has stopped flowing. So the CyberSquad teams up with Buzz to figure out the problem.

videos.title: Soil Turmoil
videos.overview: The team shrink to the size of tiny insects to try to help their earthworm friend Hapo figure out what is damaging his soil.

videos.title: Hacker Hugs a Tree
videos.overview: In an unlikely pairing, the CyberSquad helps Hacker stop a new villain named Zusk who is zapping trees with his Tree X1. After Zusk leaves due to no longer having power, Hacker uses Zusk's Tree X to plant new trees in the Northern Frontier Forest.

videos.title: Pursuit of the Prism of Power
videos.overview: The CyberSquad faces monsters, canyons, and cliffs as they pursue the Prism of Power, a vital piece of Motherboard's operating system that Hacker has stolen.

videos.title: Composting in the Clutch
videos.overview: Hacker suctions up all the dirt in Dingerville Park just before The Dingerball Series -- a once-in-every-four-year championship -- leaving CyberSquad scrambling to refill the missing dirt before the big game starts.

videos.title: A Camping Conundrum
videos.overview: Hacker suctions up all the dirt in Dingerville Park just before The Dingerball Series -- a once-in-every-four-year championship -- leaving CyberSquad scrambling to refill the missing dirt before the big game starts.

videos.title: Journey of a Thousand Food Miles
videos.overview: Jackie and Inez search everywhere for cherries so Digit can make his famous cherry supreme dessert for food critic Bone Appetit. Unfortunately, Hacker stole the last batch of cherries of the season to make "Cherries a la Hacker". After traveling all over Castleblanca and Factoria, there are still zero cherries.

videos.title: Duck Stop
videos.overview: The CyberSquad tags along as the Northern Frontier ducks migrate to Restoria, helping the flock avoid numerous hazards along the way.

videos.title: The Great Outdoors
videos.overview: The CyberSquad investigates a mysterious creature that tramples over Crestwood Park, leaving visitors too scared to enter.

videos.title: Coral Grief
videos.overview: The CyberSquad and Digit try to find the source that is heating up the ocean waters and bleaching the coral reef.

videos.title: Sustainable by Design
videos.overview: Jackie wins a chance to apprentice with fashion designer Fabio DeZine and learns it takes more than a pretty drawing to design something that makes a sustaining impact.

videos.title: Buzz and the Tree
videos.overview: It's Arbor Day in Cyberspace, but Buzz is more interested in his video game than planting a tree, so Delete calls on the CyberSquad for help.

videos.title: Hacker's Bright Idea
videos.overview: The CyberSquad awaits the return of Kacy's Comet, but a glaring light in the sky blocks out all the stars.

videos.title: The Lilting Loons
videos.overview: The CyberSquad investigates after the Lilting Loons of Botsberg go missing and their pond is replaced by trash.

videos.title: Living in Disharmony
videos.overview: Hacker's niece Harmony returns to the Northern Frontier with a new pet, Sparkletoes, which quickly outstays his welcome.

videos.title: Traffic Trouble
videos.overview: The Dingerville Dragons need to get around traffic so they can get to the field to practice.

videos.title: A Garden is Born
videos.overview: Judge Trudy's prized Prickly Peach Cacti goes missing. Meanwhile, Buzz and Delete build their own garden.

videos.title: Clean-Up on Isle 8
videos.overview: Inez grapples with giving her beloved stuffed animal heirloom to her younger brother, León. Frustrated with Buzz’s selfishness, Delete heads to Isle 8, takes a job cleaning the lake and corrals the CyberSquad to help clean it up faster.

videos.title: Weather or Not - Part 1
videos.overview: Jackie is enjoying a snowy day with her family on Earth when her house becomes mysteriously cold inside. On Stellandia, a green haze has appeared and is heating up the weather. The CyberSquad helps Bernice investigate before it gets too hot.

videos.title: Weather or Not - Part 2
videos.overview: On a mission to become extra green, Hacker unintentionally causes the weather in Stellandia to become too hot. Will the tiny but mighty Bernice the Beetle help the CyberSquad stop Hacker before it's too late?

videos.title: Trees, Please
videos.overview: Buzz, Delete and Digit take a wild ride on the wreaker; Inez and her sister have different ideas about how to fix up their building's courtyard -- Inez wants to plant trees but Camila wants a skatepark.

videos.title: If You Can't Stand the Heat
videos.overview: The CyberSquad tries to keep cool as a heat wave sweeps through the cybersite during the annual Factoria Flower Show.

videos.title: Cyberdillos in the Outfield
videos.overview: Something causes chaos at the Dingerville ballfield; Inez is forced to share her room with her younger sister.

videos.title: Hacker's Birthday Bash
videos.overview: Buzz sets out to throw the best birthday ever for Hacker. Nothing but the finest food, decorations, and music will do! There’s just one problem—Buzz’s plans will cause way too much pollution! Delete brings in the CyberSquad to help.

videos.title: The Domino Dilemma
videos.overview: A quiet day at Jackie's house is ruined by a noisy snowblower. Meanwhile, loud music in Botsberg is ruining two cyberkids' dream of setting a new domino record. The CyberSquad investigates what's causing all that racket.

videos.title: A Berry Special Mother's Day
videos.overview: Matt gets his mom a special Mother's Day gift—two adopted alpacas for their family farm! In Cyberspace, the CyberSquad go on a wild adventure, helping Hannah find the ideal spot for growing Mother’s Day cyberberries.

videos.title: A Fungus Among Us
videos.overview: Hacker has a new dastardly mission -- to glow in the dark! To do this, he steals all the mushrooms from the Southern Frontier. Except, this harms the cybersite's meeting tree! Can the CyberSquad get the fungi back and save the day?

videos.title: The Kite Flying Showdown
videos.overview: It's high-flying action and problem-solving at Big Dune Beach! Digit competes in an annual kite-flying competition and Hacker is there ruining the beach's delicate sand dunes. Can the CyberSquad protect the dunes and help Digit win?

videos.title: The Heat Beneath Your Feet
videos.overview: Buzz and Delete go on vacation to Dancing Water Springs to watch a super geyser erupt and bump into the CyberSquad. But, when Delete won't stop talking about the Earth kids, Buzz worries he may be losing his best bud.

videos.title: Fix It Time!
videos.overview: Everyone's scooters are mysteriously breaking in Botsburg! The Squad tries to uncover the cause and launches a clinic to fix them using math and engineering skills. Back home, Jackie tests her new fixing skills on a broken family heirloom.

videos.title: Leave The Leaves
videos.overview: To please his pet smirble, BB, Hacker transforms a park into a highly manicured space, but BB doesn't like it at all! To find out why, the kids time travel to collect and analyze data and help restore the park's biodiversity.

videos.title: Be There Or Be Cyber Square
videos.overview: As Hacker eyes the Cyber Square trophy, the CyberSquad helps Stellandia's beetles set up a court with fractions to defeat him. Back home, Inez uses fractions to keep peace with little brother, León.

videos.title: The Power of Patterns
videos.overview: Hacker's stolen the CyberStar. The CyberSquad races through a fizzy Asteroid Belt and solves math patterns to get it back, reclaiming their confidence along the way.

videos.title: A Vote for Belly Bowl Captain
videos.overview: The Belly Bowl is coming up and the penguins must choose a team captain! Will it be Mimi or Gabe Gibson? The Squad introduces voting as a fair way to decide.

videos.title: Take It Away
videos.overview: A compilation of three comedic shorts that feature Buzz and Delete using subtraction to catch smirbles on the loose, break a cyber world record and help Hacker's niece with a BIG math problem.

videos.title: Weigh to Go
videos.overview: Pack it! Stack it! Match it! Join in for three Cyberspace adventures where Buzz, Delete, Digit, Widget and the CyberSquad use weight to save the day.
